pictures.scene: Rembrandt van Rijn, Saul and David — the young man bent over the harp while the troubled king listens behind the curtain, a Psalm, sing to the LORD a new song
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_lied

pictures.scene: Konrad Witz, The Miraculous Draught of Fishes — Christ standing on the water with His hand raised while the net comes up heavy, for He has done wonders, His right hand and holy arm
pictures.name: pd_witz_wonder

pictures.scene: Tintoretto, The Resurrection of Christ — Christ rising in the golden light while the angels lift the slab and the guards sleep, have gained Him the victory, the LORD has proclaimed His salvation
pictures.name: pd_tintoretto_overwinning

pictures.scene: Rembrandt van Rijn, The Baptism of the Eunuch — Philip with his hand raised over the Ethiopian official kneeling by the road, and revealed His righteousness to the nations, He has remembered His love and faithfulness
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_volken

pictures.scene: Giandomenico Tiepolo, The Three Angels appearing to Abraham — Abraham face down on the ground before the angel who leans over him pointing, to the house of Israel, all the ends of the earth
pictures.name: pd_tiepolo_israel

pictures.scene: Jan Gossaert, The Adoration of the Kings — the kings from far countries kneeling before the Child with their gold, have seen the salvation of our God
pictures.name: pd_gossaert_heil

lines.text: Sing to the LORD a new song,
His right hand and holy arm
The LORD has proclaimed His salvation
and revealed His righteousness to the nations.
He has remembered His love and faithfulness
all the ends of the earth
have seen the salvation of our God.
